selectionAuthorization: The 16 October owner request authorizes the selected XR narrative, genuine project media, verified source geometry and original app recordings. The latest 18 October owner revision removes the article opening photograph and selects native Rhino 8/MCPStart high-resolution transparent front captures of the complete architectural research room. Retain original room context, geometry, materials and TV imagery; open only the obstructing front facade and approved foreground speaker/cabinet row. Temporary native capture lighting is allowed; close Rhino after capture. Unrelated sources remain private and existing research/media/model pins stay unchanged.
reviewScope: Existing research media, original phone recordings and assembled bamboo geometry retain their pinned bytes. Two genuine 4K-class responsive native Rhino Rendered front captures show the original room and complete working setup. Restore side/rear walls, ceiling, floor/carpet, doors and acoustic fixtures; hide only front glazing/frame and foreground speaker/cabinet occluders, original hidden objects and annotations. Source geometry, TV vertices/topology/UVs/materials and authored colours remain unchanged. Temporary neutral/cool/warm native lights improve depth, then are removed. Raw CAD, working copies, object-ID receipts and standalone private textures never enter the browser.
